changed_input_boundary: Top and TB changed during preliminary reads. Initial hashes were captured before those reads; later source observations include the 8-lane quant rewrite and per-bank/per-tile error mask. This record does not combine them into a frozen passing snapshot. Frozen acceptance is separate.

confirmed_findings.finding: lane_bad[4][8] was shared by all column tiles inside one m0. A failure at tile1,row0,lane0,g0 suppressed tile0,row0,lane0 at later groups and could hide the earlier production-ranked failure, as well as suppress unrelated output columns.
confirmed_findings.example: With at least two tiles, tile1/row0/lane0 fails at g0 and tile0/row0/lane0 would fail at g1. Production tile-first rank must select tile0, but the shared mask skipped its g1.
confirmed_findings.observed_correction: Frozen top uses bool lane_bad[32][656], clears all used bank/tile pairs per m0, and addresses the same bank/tile as PS for compute and bias.
confirmed_findings.status: CORRECTION_OBSERVED; broad multi-tile fault regression remains deferred; frozen source assessment separate.

static_observations: Signed S8 dot products widen to INT32; adjacent tree has no INT32 overflow at 32 terms.
R0 quant uses full F32 d and reciprocal before half RNE, then F32 product/roundf away from zero; half subnormal handling matches production converters.
W8-bank, A4-bank, FP8-bank and PS32-bank address formulas fit actual legal K/N/rows maxima; N and row tails are skipped before payload access/output.
Production first-error rank is tile,row,lane,group,phase; bad_element encoding is not the rank.
ACT TB compares complete two-word outputs, all A8 q/scales, selected eight-group actual traces, tails, reuse, trace-off, rejection and recovery; scope is ACT only.
coverage_limits: Initial ACT-only test does not execute multi-tile linear fault rank, QKV scatter, rows3/5/15/16 or maximum K/N.
Observed unused suffix words18688..32767 is not asserted by TB; q/scale/group named-region tails are asserted.
C++ work/byte counters and done flags do not establish physical AXI responses, cycles, II, RAM/DSP use or placement.
